title: VakilnaSEEG-fingerprint: sEEG seizure-onset and interictal segments of one polymicrogyria patient with electrode coordinates (Vakilna et al., 2025) (derivative)
description: Derivative sEEG dataset from one patient with bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria and intractable focal seizures, comprising short sensor-space segments of seizure onset and interictal spikes with electrode coordinates. Data were repackaged from a Brainstorm database accompanying a case study using seizure fingerprint analysis in source space to localize the epileptogenic zone. Monopolar and bipolar montage versions are provided in BrainVision format with events and electrode locations.
methods_description: Clinical stereo-EEG was recorded on a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200A at 2000 Hz, imported into Brainstorm, notch-filtered (180-900 Hz harmonics) and resampled to 1000 Hz. Segments were converted to BrainVision float32 in microvolts, with Brainstorm events written to events.tsv and contact locations (SCS, mm) to electrodes.tsv.
